title: Blue Clear Sky Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: When you're at our cottage, actually located in the town of Seaside, you'll want to kick back and relax and just move at a Snail's Pace! This 2 bedroom/ 2 bath cottage is just a hop, skip, and a jump to the beautiful, sandy beaches of Seaside.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: ▪️ 4 Houses from the Private Savannah Seaside Beach Walkover ▪️ You will have a total of 6 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals ▪️ Pet Friendly ▪️ Two beach cruiser bikes ▪️ Screened in porch and lounging upper deck ▪️ Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker ▪️Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: → There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. → Pet fee of $150 → Vacation Cancellation Protection →Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($100 fee applies at booking) Enjoy a cozy family room with a new 43" 4K LED flat screen, DVR, Blue Ray DVD Player and High-Speed Wireless Internet Access. A spacious, well-equipped kitchen and dining area await you on the main floor. A new three-part whole house water filtration system has been installed delivering bottled water quality water throughout the house. A bathroom with larger shower (no tub) & outside access, plus a closet stacked washer and dryer (also located directly outside the home) complete the main level. Upstairs you'll find the two bedrooms and a second bathroom/shower combo. The master bedroom has a Westin Heavenly™ king size mattress and Pottery Barn™ Stratton bed, ample closet space, dresser, under bed storage drawers and a new 24” LED flat screen TV. The guest room with its Westin Heavenly™ queen size mattress and Pottery Barn™ Stratton bed and flat screen TV. This bedroom has french doors to your own private balcony. The balcony has two comfortable cushioned chaise lounges - a great place to "catch some sun" read a book and just enjoy life. There is a shared full bath (shower only) in the hall. Also provided is a portable crib, child gate, highchair and numerous games and puzzles that are sure to keep the kids busy after a long day at the beach! Up one more level you'll find the best seats in the house! Complete with two twin day beds with Westin Heavenly™ mattresses and lots of comfortable pillows to relax and lounge on. Open the windows to hear the waves crash onto the beach or turn on the new 39” LED flat screen TV or new Blue Ray DVD player and enjoy a movie. The tower will quickly become your favorite room in the house! The view of the town and of the gulf are awesome. Kids love to play up here and adults love to come up and have cocktails and enjoy the sunset. There is a small balcony off of the tower to look at the Seaside skyline. There are chairs, umbrellas, toys, and floats provided for your beach enjoyment. The home is even equipped with whole house air UV air purification system!!! ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 6) 1st floor- ✦ Living room with ample seating, Large TV, Kitchen, screened porch and full bath (shower only) with access to outdoor shower and w/d 2nd floor- ✦Bedroom 1: King master, TV ✦Bedroom 2: Queen, TV ✦Shared hall bathroom (shower only) 3rd floor- ✦Loft with 2 twin daybeds, TV IMPORTANT DETAILS: ✦ There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. ✦ 1 parking pass included for street parking in front of home ✦ Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. ✦ Pet friendly with a $150 nonrefundable pet fee. Two pet limit with a $250 total fee. FREE WIFI

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
